cascadeInspection: The final DOM, cascade, source-derived anatomy, destinations, owned image, and all ten fresh captures were independently checked. One content-height section owns one constrained ren-switcher with one copy region and one image region. The copy contains exactly one h1, one description, and exactly two real CTA anchors in a wrapping ren-cluster. A single DOM tree preserves copy-first reading/focus order through 1023px; from 1024px only visual order changes to image-left/copy-right while equal peers remain vertically centered. The image is local, meaningful, intrinsically sized, rounded, and cover-fitted. No raw flex/grid skeleton, viewport forcing, form, nav, logo, video, dialog, overlay, third CTA, duplicate tree, forbidden palette token, hardcoded chromatic color, framework code, or script remains.

independentReview.notes: Independent Codex review rechecked reference lineage, acceptance criteria, HTML, focused tests and all ten PNGs. Mobile and tablet retain copy then image; the 1023/1024 seam switches exactly once to image-left/copy-right; both real CTA destinations resolve; touch, focus, no-JavaScript, reduced-motion and theme states remain coherent. The 1280 by 900 local screenshot is a truthful landscape image with matching intrinsic metadata. No correction or recapture was necessary.
